producer_report.summary: The free-disk check of the checks stage now runs after the job's own writer build is removed. It runs only just before the first check that actually runs locally. Root cause: `check_and_verify` called `disk_gate` before `free_producer_build` and before the CI result was read, so the job's own build, or a CI result that would have replaced the checks, could hold the job. The up-front gate in `check_and_verify` is gone. `SnapExec::exec` (run/checks.rs) now calls the existing `disk_gate` once, after `refuse_if_stopped` and before the first check runs. Low space returns the `LowDisk` error, which passes up unchanged through `run_local`, `Fallback` and `run_routed_with_record`. `check_and_verify` downcasts it, removes the verify snapshot and returns the existing `hold_for_disk`. A green or red CI result, a resumed job and a fully skipped route never reach `exec`. The dispatch, producer and verifier gates are unchanged. Because the verify snapshot now exists before the new gate, the "checks have passed" signal in the free-space helpers changed from "a verify dir exists" to `test_support::verifier_stage_reached`. It reads the Verifier-stage resume mark. The drain tests need a GitHub origin without reaching a network, so `early_seam` and `ci_seam` are now also compiled under the `test-support` feature. With no seam installed, behaviour outside this crate's own tests is unchanged. `test_support` gained `CiReplies` (a fake `gh` that answers green or no run), `CiAnswer` and `install_github_fakes`. New drain tests: the writer build is cleared before the gate so the job is not held; a green CI run is reused with no hold and prints the `ci         checks reused` line; and two hold cases (no origin, and a GitHub origin with no CI run) that hold before the local run and resume after a retry with space. The changelog, `docs/architecture.md` and the `disk.rs` doc comments describe the new order. Not changed, and out of scope for criterion 6: the `docs/architecture.md` sentence that says the last two gates close the job as failed with an `athena retry` hint. It no longer matches the hold behaviour.

It asserts Finished and Landed, a `ci         checks reused from` line, a `checks     ` line, no `held       ` line, the fake gh was asked, and one CI push on the fake. Companion cases `low_disk_with_no_ci_result_holds_before_the_local_run_and_a_retry_with_space_runs_the_checks` (no origin) and `low_disk_with_a_github_origin_and_no_ci_run_holds_before_the_local_run` (fake gh answers no run). I ran clippy only after writing the drain tests and got one `expect_err` lint, which I then fixed. The policy scan ran before the final changelog edit and rustfmt pass. I did not re-run it afterwards; the changelog and docs avoid the listed words.
learnings: The `athena-cli` integration tests build `athena-core` with the `test-support` feature but without cfg(test), so the CI and early-PR seams were absent there. A GitHub origin in a drain test would have reached the real gh and git remote until both seams were widened.

`StateDir::read_resume` parses `kept/<id>/resume.json`. The Verifier-stage mark is written after every check passes and just before the verifier gate, so it is a reliable 'checks done' signal in free-space readers.
`LowDisk` is `Copy` and implements `std::error::Error`, so `Err(low.into())` and `downcast_ref` work. The error survives `Fallback` and `run_local` unchanged.
The workspace denies `missing_debug_implementations`, so new public test_support types need Debug.

`low_once_built` no longer holds a job whose own build is the cause, since the build is removed first. Any test that needs a hold at the checks gate must key on the verify snapshot with the checks not yet passed.
